 Matching cool‑season grass varieties to alfalfa’s Reproductive Maturity (RM) is essential to preserving yield and forage quality in mixed stands. DLF’s Forage Maturity Index standardizes maturity ratings across species, helping producers choose grasses—such as orchardgrass, tall fescue, meadow fescue, timothy, festulolium, and perennial ryegrass—that align with alfalfa’s first‑cut harvest timing. Newer “late” or “early” varieties prevent grasses from maturing too far ahead or behind alfalfa. This system, supported by ongoing university–industry collaboration, gives producers a practical tool for selecting varieties that synchronize growth and optimize total‑forage performance. # DLF CONSUMER BRANDS

 Deer Creek Seed by DLF, a premier seed outlet backed by the global leader in seed research production, offers top-quality forage, turf, cover crop, and food plot seeds to U.S. consumers who enjoy easy ordering, fast shipping and dedicated support. 

 Founded in 2004, X-Seed® by DLF has evolved from coir-based lawn patches to a premium range of lawn, pasture, and wildflower seeds. Leveraging DLF’s expertise, X-Seed® offers innovative, low-maintenance solutions with high durability, disease resistance, and enhanced growth. 

 ForageMax® by DLF offers a range of high-performance forage grasses and legumes tested for palatability, yield, persistency, and quality in North American climates. Our science-based approach ensures superior nutrition and economic benefits for milk and livestock production. 

 Mastergreen® by DLF provides a science-driven approach for sustainable landscapes, delivering exceptional results for lawns and sports fields. Its 4-N-1 technology promotes quicker germination and strong root development, optimizing nutrition and water utilization for healthy seedlings. 

 4Most Seed Enhancement by DLF is an eco-friendly solution for turf and forage, combining slow-release nitrogen, beneficial microbes, and a biodegradable moisture-retaining starch. It enhances seed performance, promotes faster growth, and reduces the need for additional fertilizers. 

 Microclover® is a small-leaved white clover that grows between turf grasses, naturally supplying nitrogen and creating a dense, resilient turf. It reduces fertilizer needs, enhances wear tolerance, and thrives in diverse conditions, offering a sustainable, cost-effective turf solution.

# DLF Consumer Turf Products

 Turf seed products are vital for creating and maintaining healthy, attractive, and functional turf areas. High-quality turf seed is crucial for establishing dense, resilient lawns that withstand wear and tear from foot traffic, recreational activities, and environmental stresses. These products contribute to a variety of settings, including residential lawns, sports fields, golf courses, and public parks. Well-maintained turf improves property values, enhances aesthetics, provides recreational opportunities, and plays a role in environmental benefits such as erosion control, air quality improvement, and stormwater management. 

Microclover

MICROCLOVER® - Many years of natural selection have resulted in revolutionary micro clovers with all the benefits of traditional clover packed into very tiny leaves. HEALTHY & LUSH - Micro clover® “spoon feeds” nitrogen to the grass, producing a healthy, dense, and naturally green lawn that is easy to maintain. 

Houndogs Tall Fescue Blend

Houndog™ Turf-Type Tall Fescue Blend contains at least three top DLF Pickseed varieties for superior turf performance, disease resistance and with minimal inputs. 

5 Way Fescue Turf Mix

5 Way Fescue Turf Mix is a blend of 5 elite turf-type tall fescues. Ideal for more southern growing zones, this mix is heat and drought tolerant. 

Ultra-Premium Bluegrass Blend

Carefully selected for its fine texture, rich color, and superior performance, this blend promises a luxurious, dense turf that will be the envy of your neighborhood.

Ultra-Premium High Traffic South Blend

Ultra-Premium High Traffic Mix is a 100% blend of Perennial Ryegrass varieties. This improved turf-type perennial blend has a fine texture, good disease resistance, and emerald green color. 

Tall Fescue Blend

Tall Fescue Blend is a top choice for creating lush, resilient Northern lawns. With its deep roots and exceptional drought tolerance, tall fescue thrives in various climates, requiring minimal watering and maintenance.

Fast Lawn

X-Seed Fast Lawn is the perfect solution for quick and reliable lawn establishment, with rapid germination in just 3 to 5 days. Designed as a one-year grass solution, it provides a lush, temporary lawn that won’t return the following year, making it ideal for short-term projects.

MicroLawn Slow & Low Mix

MicroLawn Slow & Low Mix is an adaptable mix of perennial ryegrass, fescues, and micro-clover. It is formulated for dependable, even growth in high-traffic areas ranging from full sun to light shade. 

MasterGreen Sun to Shade Turf Mix

MasterGreen® Sun to Shade is a premium lawn mixture created for partial shade to full sun environments.

Deep Shade Turfgrass Mix

X-Seed Deep Shade Mix is specially formulated to thrive in low-light areas, making it the perfect solution for lawns with 4 to 7 hours of filtered sunlight per day. Designed for hard-to-grow spots, this premium grass seed blend ensures a lush, green lawn even in dense shade.

Ultra-Premium Hardy Lawn Mix

Ultra-Premium Hardy Mix contains a blend of fantastic cool-season turfgrasses to build a beautiful lawn tolerant of whatever you can throw at it.

Ultra-Premium Shady Lawn Mix

Ultra-Premium Shady Mix contains a blend of fantastic cool-season turfgrasses to build a beautiful lawn with improved shade tolerance.

Landscaper Mix

Landscaper Mix contains annual ryegrass, turf-type tall fescue, and perennial ryegrass for a quick, cost-effective lawn.

Ultra-Premium Quick & Thick Sun to Shade Mix

Sun to Shade Turfgrass Mix is a mixture of cool-season grasses formulated to provide quick soil cover, minimizing weed growth and erosion. 

Ultra-Premium High Traffic Blend

Ultra-Premium High Traffic Blend is 100% perennial ryegrass, an excellent choice for high-traffic lawns due to its exceptional wear tolerance and quick recovery properties.

Quick & Thick Plus Lawn Repair Mix

Quick & Thick Plus lawn repair is a blend of disease-resistant, drought-tolerant improved varieties, designed to grow thick turf quickly.

Quick & Thick Renew Seed & Feed

Quick & Thick Renew Seed & Feed is a blend of disease-resistant, drought-tolerant improved varieties, designed to grow thick turf quickly. 

50/50 Kentucky Bluegrass/Perennial Ryegrass Turf Mix

50/50 Kentucky Bluegrass/Perennial Ryegrass Turf Mix is a blend of Kentucky Bluegrasses and Perennial Ryegrasses for quick emergence while Kentucky Bluegrasses fills in.

Chewings Fescue (Fine)

Chewings fescue is a type of bunch grass that grows upright with a fine textured leaf blade. It is an excellent variety for shaded, sandy and low fertility areas.

Fawn Tall Fescue

Fawn tall forage fescue is an endophyte free, cool season bunchgrass. This deep-rooted variety is tolerant of intensive grazing and animal traffic.

Festulolium

Festulolium is a cross of perennial ryegrass and meadow fescue. It is a bunchgrass that is easy to establish due to its rapid germination and seedling vigor.

Kentucky 31 Tall Fescue

Kentucky 31 tall fescue is a cool season bunchgrass commonly grown across North America in pastures and lawns.

Low Grow Fescue Turf Mix

Low Grow Turf Mix is ideal for low input lawns. This mixture of fescues naturally grows low to the ground and forms a dense, flowing carpet of sod.

Meadow Fescue

Meadow fescue is a cool season, semi-bunch type grass. It is widely adapted for use in pastures or dry hay production. It yields slightly less than orchardgrass or tall fescue, but has better fiber digestibility. It performs better than most forage grasses on moist soils.

Minnfine Kentucky Bluegrass

Minnfine Kentucky bluegrass is a common variety of Kentucky bluegrass similar in characteristics to Park Kentucky bluegrass. 

Pasco Turf Perennial Ryegrass

Pasco perennial ryegrass is widely used as a component in lawn seed mixtures. It provides quick cover with its rapid germination.

Pollinator Friendly Turf Mix

Pollinator Friendly Turf Mix provides a worry-free low maintenance lawn. The NON-GMO formula produces a lush/green turf while the white clovers provide nutrition for its grass partner. 

Sandy Soil Turf Mix

Use Sandy Soil Turf Mix for a quality, deep-rooted turf with good color and persistence on dry, sandy soils. 

Shady Turf Mix

Shady Turf Mix produces a fine-textured lawn in areas of moderate to heavy shade (with at least two hours of sunlight). 

Speedy Green Turf Mix

All-purpose Speedy Green Turf Mix is an economical mixture with extremely quick emergence and cover. This mix can be used in sun or light shaded areas. 

Sun & Shade Turf Mix

For a quality, "all-purpose" lawn, Sun & Shade is an optimal mixture that thrives under full sun as well as moderate shade.

Sunny Turf Mix

Sunny Turf Mix is an elite mix of Kentucky bluegrass, perennial ryegrass, and creeping red fescue. 

Turf Type Perennial Ryegrass

Turf type perennial ryegrass is widely used as a component in lawn seed mixtures. It provides quick cover with its rapid germination. 

Bermudagrass

Bermudagrass is a highly versatile and resilient warm-season grass, ideal for both lush home lawns and durable pastureland. 

Quick & Thick Dog Spot Repair Mix

Quick & Thick Dog Spot Repair is used to repair spots in established lawns damaged by pet urine.

Annual Ryegrass (Turf)

Turf-Type Annual Ryegrass is a versatile species used for cover cropping and lawn applications. It is a cool season bunch grass known for its rapid germination. 

Microlawn & Microclover Grass Seed Mix

This adaptable mix of turf-type tall fescues, perennial ryegrass, and micro-clover is formulated for dependable, even growth in high-traffic areas ranging from full sun to light shade.

MasterGreen 5 Way Tall Fescue

MasterGreen® 5-Way Tall Fescue is an ideal all-around mix suited for high traffic areas that experience both sun and shade.

## TESTIMONIALS

BRUNO AND PIER-OLIVIER PARADIS FERME PARADUC It has already been five years since we incorporated DLF alfalfa varieties into our crop rotation, alongside DLF’s corn hybrids. We have observed a tangible difference in our herd’s performance. Without making any changes to our management practices or feed milling operations, milk production per cow increased right from the very first season. The forage quality of DLF products is superior: the alfalfa offers consistent nutritional value, while the corn hybrids yield a more energy-rich and uniform silage—benefits that are directly reflected in our milk production. Establishment—that is, the emergence of the alfalfa varieties—occurs rapidly. The fields emerge uniformly, and the stand remains dense and vigorous throughout our 4-to-5-year forage rotation. LAWN SEED FAQ WHEN TO SEED Seeding can be done May to mid-June however the best time is between late August to September. Overseed in spring and fall for maximum weed control. Initial growth for most varieties are expected to begin in 7 days, given adequate moisture and warm soil conditions for germination. 
SOIL PREPARATION 
Lightly rake the soil surface to remove any thatch or debris and to roughen or loosen the soil. The grass seed must have contact 
with the soil in order to germinate. Do not bury the seed or it could fail to emerge. 
APPLYING SEED 
For small areas, apply by hand. For larger areas, use a fertilizer spreader and distribute seed evenly in two directions. Rake lightly 
and roll for good seed soil contact. 
FERTILIZER 
Apply fertilizer every 4-6 weeks during growing season. 
WATERING 
Keep newly seeded areas moist for first 6 weeks. Do not let the soil dry out in between waterings and don’t allow the water to pool. 
MOWING 
First mowing should take place 3-6 weeks when the grass seedlings reach 2-3 inches in height. 
OVERSEEDING 
A thick, healthy lawn is the best defense against weeds, disease, drought and insect damage. Overseeding can quickly repair a 
lawn that is thin and patchy and helps to crowd out weeds.

### BENTGRASS TO NEW BENTGRASS

1. Do not apply a preemergent herbicide before seeding. 
2. Use a growth regulator 1 week before and wait at least 2 weeks after. 
3. Reduce height of cut on existing turf (scalp <0.1 or lower for greens). 
4. Verticut heavily to reduce thatch and further weaken existing turf (can also follow aerification). 
5. Core aerify with largest acceptable tines to create holes and topdress or drag cores to fill holes. Dimple tines, Graden sand inject or spiking have also worked. Key is reduce competition and have seed to soil contact. Slit seeders are also successful. 
6. Best times for establishment are late spring through the summer into early fall. Seeding dates of June 19, July1, August 17 and 20 were most successful in New Jersey trials and August seeding dates in Indiana. Dormant seeding or early spring can work in areas with winter damage. 
7. Seed with MacKenzie, 007XL, Tillinghast, Futura Pro, Futura Pro Extreme, and MacDonald(DLPS-AP/3018) at 1-3 lbs/1000 sq. ft. (5 -15 gr/sq. m) and topdress or drag seed in. Utilization of 4Most enhanced seed may increase your success rate. 
8. Water at least 1 time per day and use wetting agents if needed. 
9. Fertilize lightly with foliar spray after seeds germinate. 
10. Keep height of cut low to enable more light to seedlings, reduce competition and encourage spread of new seedlings. 
11. Repeat late spring, summer and early fall for at least two years. Take before and after photos so you can see progress.
